text: BAM share rose 0.16 percentage points over 21 hours to 37.5%, while the 7 day move remains down 0.33 percentage points. Concentration is elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 26.4% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The latest top-node change reflects whale-driven routing from sqq-mainnet-bam-1-tee to ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee, not broad validator churn.
